Subject: Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
(“Listing Regulations”): Update on analyst/ institutional investors meet (virtual)  
 
Dear Madam/ Sir, 
 
Further to our letter PKR:SG: 33:2026-27 and PKR:SG: 36:2026-27 dated 23rd July 2026 and 4th August 2026, 
respectively, this is to inform you that an analyst/ institutional investors meet (virtual) concluded today i.e.,  
4th August 2026 and in terms of Regulation 30 read with Part A of Schedule III of the Listing Regulations, the 
audio-video recording of analyst/ institutional investors meet has been uploaded on the Company’s website at 
https://www.nestle.in/investors/analystsmeet. 
 
The above is for your information and record.  
 
Thanking you,  
 
Yours truly, 
 
 
NESTLÉ INDIA LIMITED
